text:
elena: FYI I opened a tiny PR to add a compact parsing example for function/tool-calls + a JSON-schema fallback note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821

ravi: nice — can you show both the direct structured return + the envelope pattern? A lot of customers are using the envelope for metadata.

morgan: agree on the envelope. also we should include a short parser shim for nullable arrays (seen lots of edgecases).

elena: good call. current PR has this minimal example:
```json
{
  "name": "get_weather",
  "arguments": {"location": "seattle", "units": "metric"}
}
```
and a fallback suggestion to validate with the schema and coerce: use `safeParse` before `invoke` result.

kai: I can add an SDK snippet showing `parseStructuredOutput(response, schema)` with a try/catch and fallback to `rawText` — will push a commit shortly.

ravi: when you add the SDK example, pls keep it <=8 lines and show the error message we expect so docs tests can assert on it.

docs-bot: CI started for PR #4821 — lint: pending, md-link-check: running, examples-tests: queued.

morgan: also pinging eng-runtime to confirm the recommended `schema` field name `output_schema_v1` matches what the runtime emits. @kai can you double-check?

kai: checked — runtime emits `output_schema` currently; I'll change the docs to `output_schema` and add a short note about the planned rename.

elena: thanks. I'll amend the PR with: 1) envelope + direct examples, 2) nullable array shim, 3) 6-line SDK helper, 4) link to runtime issue for rename.

ravi: :+1: once examples-tests pass, I'll do a quick editorial pass and merge.

morgan: minor nit: add a short sentence about guardrail behavior when extra fields appear (we recommend ignoring unknown fields, show `additionalProperties: true`).

elena: added that to the draft. Marking for review: @ravi @morgan — please review when CI is green.

kai: pushed the SDK snippet commit. PR now 5 commits.

docs-bot: CI success for PR #4821 — lint: pass, md-link-check: pass, examples-tests: pass.

ravi: reviewing now, quick pass.

morgan: LGTM, small grammar fix noted in line 42.

elena: thanks all — merging after ravi's review.

ravi: Approved and merged. :tada:
